quotes: For a specified nondegenerate gapped electronic Hamiltonian and perturbations \(V_i\), define \(K_{ij}=2\operatorname{Re}\sum_{n>0}\langle0|V_i|n\rangle\langle n|V_j|0\rangle/(E_n-E_0)\). Then \(K\) is positive semidefinite and \(I_{\rm quad}(q)=-q^TKq/2\). Consistent relaxed DFT curvature must replace this exact-eigenstate expression when testing B3LYP; a bare Kohn-Sham transition sum is not sufficient.

A separate positive-semidefinite matrix control uses \(K=\begin{pmatrix}1&0.8\\0.8&1\end{pmatrix}\), \(D=(1,0)\), and \(q=(1,-0.8)^T\). A visible-direction fit gives energy -0.5 but the full quadratic energy is -0.18. Thus mixed visible/hidden response can yield a positive correction 0.32, despite negative induction in the isolated hidden direction. This checks the sign caveat in joint ledger #7, not a molecular mechanism.
